hypothesis: Hypothesis: For MLP models, the crossover between CPU and discrete GPU (NVIDIA RTX 5070) follows model weight footprint relative to the 64 MB CPU cache (AMD Ryzen 9 8940HX L3 cache), rather than FLOP count. MLPs possess low arithmetic intensity (~1.0 FLOP/byte), meaning every parameter is read once per sample. When weights fit inside the 64 MB CPU cache, the CPU avoids DRAM latency and runs at on-die cache bandwidth, outperforming the dGPU which incurs PCIe dispatch latency overhead. When MLP weights exceed 64 MB, CPU execution must stream from system DDR5 RAM, allowing the RTX 5070's high-bandwidth GDDR6 VRAM to dominate.
